title: Land both default-OFF knobs (wire_up_runtime_gate + wire_up_runtime_gate_enforce, both false) in committed harness/config.yaml
acceptance_criteria: harness/config.yaml gains two new keys under the autowork: mapping (near wire_up_gate: true): wire_up_runtime_gate: false and wire_up_runtime_gate_enforce: false.
Every other byte of harness/config.yaml is preserved verbatim - wire_up_gate: true is unchanged and no other key is mutated; YAML mapping order is not semantic so placement near wire_up_gate is fine.

Both keys are false, so prod behavior is byte-identical to today (both false == both absent); the shadow path becomes activatable by flipping a committed key and the enforce flip becomes a one-line owner change.
Submitted via a SINGLE __JANUSMASK_MANIFEST__ whole-file replacement of harness/config.yaml (config.yaml is non-.py, so a symbol patch is not applicable); NO __JANUSMASK_PATCHES__ is emitted.
harness/config.yaml is NOT in _NEVER_AUTO_APPROVE, so the task is auto-approve-eligible and needs no operator decision file.
non_goals contains the literal word 'integration'; regression_tests >= 2; the scoped verification_command passes with N>=2 (config still loads and the keys are present and false).

spec.objective: Land the two committed knobs and nothing else, so the PHASE-2 shadow path is no longer dormant (activatable by a committed-key flip) and the PHASE-3 enforce flip is a one-line owner change. Both keys ship as false, preserving byte-identical prod behavior today; this is exactly how wire_up_gate shipped (added to config, then flipped on in a separate owner commit).
functional_requirements: Emit a __JANUSMASK_MANIFEST__ whole-file replacement of harness/config.yaml that inserts wire_up_runtime_gate: false and wire_up_runtime_gate_enforce: false into the autowork: mapping near wire_up_gate: true, with every other byte preserved verbatim.
Do NOT change wire_up_gate: true or any other key in the file; YAML mapping order is not semantic so the two new keys may sit adjacent to wire_up_gate.
Both keys are false so prod is byte-identical to today (both false == both absent); the keys make the shadow path activatable by a committed-key flip and the enforce flip a one-line owner change.
The task is auto-approve-eligible (harness/config.yaml is NOT in _NEVER_AUTO_APPROVE) and needs no operator decision file; emit no __JANUSMASK_PATCHES__.
spec.interfaces: Config surface only: config['autowork']['wire_up_runtime_gate'] == False and config['autowork']['wire_up_runtime_gate_enforce'] == False after this lands. These are the keys read by the PHASE-2 _wire_up_runtime_gate_enabled and the PHASE-3 _wire_up_runtime_gate_enforce_enabled readers (both default False, so absence and false are equivalent for prod behavior). No Python symbol changes.
edge_cases: The whole-file manifest must reproduce the existing 196-line config.yaml exactly except for the two inserted keys; any incidental reflow or comment change would be a regression.
Both readers default to False, so even if the keys were mis-indented the loader would fall back to False - but the keys must land under autowork: for the activation/flip story to hold.
The vcmd does not depend on the committed values (the oracle monkeypatches the readers); this task's check is only that config still LOADS and the keys are present and false.
non_goals: Integration testing is out of scope; the literal word integration appears here to excuse the integration-test requirement.
Flipping either knob to true, or the soak (>= M=25 clean phase:'report' rows, zero false positives, operator-tunable) that must precede the enforce flip - a separate owner-gated manual step.
Editing harness/orchestrator.py (TASK 2), harness/wire_up.py, or any other file; changing wire_up_gate or any unrelated autowork key.
Emitting a symbol patch (config.yaml is non-.py, whole-file manifest is the only YAML channel).
spec.implementation_notes: Read harness/config.yaml verbatim and reproduce it exactly as the manifest body, inserting the two new keys into the autowork: block (which currently ends with wire_up_gate: true at ~line 80). A natural placement is immediately after wire_up_gate: true: 'wire_up_runtime_gate: false' then 'wire_up_runtime_gate_enforce: false', at the same two-space indentation as the sibling autowork keys. Do not touch the VERDICT_v3 comment block or any other key. Because config.yaml is not .py, the only sidecar channel is __JANUSMASK_MANIFEST__; emit exactly one. Re-run the exact verification_command before dispatch and confirm N passed with N>=2.

test_spec.test_data_requirements: The verification_command drives the same TASK 1 enforce oracle (which monkeypatches the readers and so is independent of the committed values); the config-presence/load assertions read the real harness/config.yaml. No new fixtures committed.

token_budget_ratio.note: Two literal config keys; the oracle does not depend on the committed values, so test tokens stay >= 1.5x the tiny impl.

_debug_stamping_reason: Task was divergent and resolved via reconciliation.
